findings.detail: The rate-fill warning is driven by source-blank unfunded delayed-draw and revolving loan rows, not by missed disclosed interest-rate cells.

rationale: The raw SOI schedule explicitly has Reference Rate and Interest Rate columns. Funded loan rows for the same issuers show rates, for example 2080 Media rows 26/28/29/31 have SF spreads and 8.42%-8.57% interest rates, while adjacent 2080 Media rows 27 and 30 omit both rate fields and carry negative cost/zero fair value. The commitment table separately identifies those omitted-rate rows as delayed draw or revolving loan commitments. The same source-blank pattern appears for ABC Legal Holdings and Carbon Topco. Therefore the low direct-lending rate fill is caused by the check counting source-blank unfunded commitment rows as violations, not by a data extraction error.
